name: qianwen-crawler-web
description: Repeated Qianwen (千问 www.qianwen.com) web question collection with per-question evidence and optional UI grouping.
input_files: required standard inputs: repeat count, target entity, entity type
optional Qianwen group name for UI grouping
output_contract: raw/<sample_id>.json per-sample evidence with chat_url link evidence
group.json group enumeration result (authoritative link source)
questions-missing.json list of questions needing a re-ask
rollback_boundary: The skill writes only to the selected run output directory and does not modify the source Qianwen session.
local_dependencies: OpenCLI Browser Bridge profile with Qianwen login
